dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Star was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no known history on her behavior in a home environment. Star has not acclimated well to the kennel environment and has shown highly fearful behavior; during her handling assessment she was shaking and would freeze in place, though would quickly lean in to handlers when they knelt down to her or picked her up. Due to her levels of fear, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide a period of decompression and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Star
